title: observability: automate Prometheus/Grafana + logging for Private installs (Helm, Terraform, dashboards, alerts)
author: Ava Martinez
description: Automates observability provisioning for Private installs (VPC/on-prem) by wiring Prometheus, Grafana, and log shipping into the private-installer flow. Motivation: customers installing Redwood in private networks consistently ask for a reproducible observability stack (metrics, dashboards, alerting, and centralized logs). This PR provides: 1) Helm chart updates and templates to deploy a curated Prometheus + Grafana stack with sensible defaults and minimal surface area for air-gapped environments; 2) Terraform module additions to provision observability-related infra (S3-compatible object storage for Prometheus remote write snapshots, optional external load balancer configuration, and IAM/KMS placeholders for secrets); 3) log shipping integration (Fluent Bit config and chart) to forward structured logs to customer-provided endpoints; 4) a set of pre-baked Grafana dashboards and Alertmanager rules tuned for Private runtime SLOs; 5) installer hooks that run as part of private-installer apply flow with idempotent upgrade/rollback support. Checklist: - [x] Helm charts: prometheus-stack chart, fluentbit chart, grafana dashboards packaging - [x] Terraform module: observability module with documented variables - [x] Installer integration: add --enable-observability flag and hooks - [x] Dashboards: 6 dashboards (runtime, kv-cache, routing, infra, logs overview, cost breakdown) - [x] Alerting: default alertmanager rules + silence templates - [x] Docs: private-installer observability guide + upgrade notes - [x] E2E smoke tests for chart rendering and installer dry-run Known limitations: - Does not include managed Prometheus remote-write receivers; customers must configure their endpoints. - Some dashboards reference metrics that will be available only after the runtime has been instrumented in a subsequent PR (ENG-3201).

release_notes: Adds automated observability provisioning for Private installs: Prometheus + Grafana charts, Fluent Bit log shipping, Terraform observability module, installer hooks, dashboards, and alerting rules. Customers can enable via --enable-observability flag during private-installer apply.
